data.name: Tulliana
data.gender_notes: Tulliana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Tullia', which means 'leaping' or 'shining'. In Roman mythology, Tullia was a goddess associated with fertility and the harvest. This name is often used in Christian contexts to honor the Virgin Mary, the mother of Jesus, who is also associated with fertility and the harvest. The name Tulliana carries the meaning “Leaping, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tulliana usually hope their child will grow to embody leaping, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tulliana total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
